scope: Remaining resident functions with positive u3 runtime hits after libpad and boundary correction

names.name: contact_record_billboard_render
names.rationale: Projects active contact records and emits their billboard quads into the ordering table.

names.name: gte_far_color_set_save
evidence: static:reads GTE RFC/GFC/BFC, stores them, then writes one replacement value to all three
names.rationale: Saves the GTE far-color triplet and installs a uniform far color.

names.name: gte_screen_xy_fifo_read
evidence: static:reads GTE SXY0/SXY1/SXY2 into three words
names.rationale: Copies the projected screen-coordinate FIFO to memory.

names.name: gte_color_matrix_load_symmetric
evidence: static:writes five packed words to GTE color-matrix control registers
names.rationale: Loads the symmetric five-halfword color matrix used by the object renderer.

names.name: gte_lighting_vector_transform
evidence: static:loads a vector, executes GTE lighting operation, returns three biased/scaled MAC values
names.rationale: Transforms one lighting vector through the active GTE lighting matrix.

names.name: gte_quad_near_clip_dispatch
evidence: static:classifies four projected depths against near plane
static:dispatches to three local clipped-quad emitters
names.rationale: Classifies a quad's near-plane intersections and dispatches the required clipped primitive emitter.

names.name: gte_quad_clip_emit_variant_a
evidence: static:interpolates projected positions/UVs and emits clipped GT4 primitives
names.rationale: One near-plane quad-clipping emission variant.

names.name: gte_quad_clip_emit_variant_b
evidence: static:interpolates projected positions/UVs and emits clipped GT4 primitives
names.rationale: Second near-plane quad-clipping emission variant.

names.name: gte_quad_clip_emit_variant_c
evidence: static:interpolates projected positions/UVs and emits clipped GT4 primitives
names.rationale: Third near-plane quad-clipping emission variant.

names.name: queued_billboard_quad_render
evidence: static:builds POLY_GT4 packets and links them into the OT
names.rationale: Renders the queued billboard/effect quad list.

names.name: pass2_object_transform_update
evidence: static:writes one angle and three transform words to the selected pass-2 object
names.rationale: Updates transform fields for one pass-2 scene object.

names.name: gte_mesh_assembler_counted
names.rationale: Counted wrapper around the RTPS mesh assembler.

names.name: controller_input_update
evidence: static:decodes digital, analog, mouse, and controller state into resident input globals
names.rationale: Polls controller port 0, normalizes device-specific input, and returns the game button mask.

names.name: controller_input_latch_update
evidence: static:moves current input mask to previous then calls controller_input_update
names.rationale: Advances the previous/current controller-input latch once per presented frame.

names.name: gpu_timing_marker_append
evidence: static:appends counter value and packed RGB command to timing arrays
names.rationale: Appends one color-coded marker to the resident GPU timing sample list.

names.name: gpu_timing_markers_begin
evidence: static:seeds first timing sample and resets count to one
names.rationale: Begins a new GPU timing-marker sequence.

names.name: render_zone_gating_update
evidence: static:maps camera position into a serpentine grid
static:XORs render_body_gating_mask entries while crossing cells
names.rationale: Updates zone-based renderer gating as the camera crosses resource-grid cells.

names.name: mover_vm_dispatch_next
evidence: static:decodes the next signed opcode and resumes event_bytecode_interpreter state
names.rationale: Shared continuation that dispatches the next mover VM opcode.

names.name: controller_action_mask_update
evidence: static:remaps current button mask through a six-byte per-profile table into DAT_80082488
names.rationale: Builds the gameplay action mask from the current controller mapping profile.

names.name: SetRCnt
evidence: static:configures one of three root-counter records
names.rationale: PsyQ root-counter configuration API.

names.name: GetRCnt
names.rationale: PsyQ root-counter read API.

names.name: StartRCnt
names.rationale: PsyQ root-counter start API.

names.name: StopRCnt
names.rationale: PsyQ root-counter stop API.

names.name: ResetRCnt
names.rationale: PsyQ root-counter reset API.
